curriculumTime: Arabic, French or Mandarin: 48 yearly hours in each of years 7 and 8
At years 9 to 10/11 an elective language carries 80 yearly hours per subject
The years 9-11 language electives add Malay literature and English literature to the three
At years 7 and 8 students must choose one of Arabic, French or Mandarin
Each core subject, English Language included, gets 112 yearly hours at years 9 to 10/11

sources.label: UNESCO IBE, World Data on Education 7th edition (2010/11), Brunei Darussalam country profile — yearly lesson timetables for secondary education under SPN 21, grades 7-8 and grades 9 to 10/11
